overall_notes: The extraction quality was generally good. The paper focuses on text style transfer using adversarial training with pretrained models. Main contributions include energy-based interpretation of fluency degradation and a novel approach using BART for all components. Automatic evaluation uses style accuracy, content preservation, and fluency metrics. Human evaluation was conducted on selected datasets.
